en: A vintage tinted photograph of a crowded sandy beach in a curved bay beneath steep, stratified cliffs. Many people are sunbathing and swimming; simple beach structures or cabanas made from reeds or wood appear in the foreground. The sea is calm, and the coastline with wooded cliffs stretches into the distance. At the bottom left, there is a short title in Cyrillic script.
